event.label: Still listed in 1940, the last directory transcribed so far

body.p: Barry Street runs north from the corner of Queensberry and Leicester streets to Grattan Street, along the west side of University Square.
It first appears in the Sands & McDougall directories in 1862, and is listed in every directory after that up to 1940, the last one transcribed so far.

div.head: Along the street
div.p: The directories list Barry Street from south to north, one side at a time. On the east side, facing the square, they give these crossings and turnings:

list.item: Leicester Street (listed from 1900, where the two streets meet at Queensberry Street)

div.p: On the west side the order is Queensberry Street, Agra Place (1878 to 1905), Pelham Street, then a run of small terraces and lanes, Everton Cottages (1879 to 1885), Vernon Place (1879 to 1895) and Eliza Terrace (1869 to 1905), before Grattan Street. Rights-of-way are noted on the west side from 1895.

div.head: Businesses and landmarks

list.item: Royal and Co, engineers, at No. 2 on the east side from 1862 into the 1880s. The firm is also listed in Leicester Street from 1862, later as axle makers.
The Sir Redmond Barry Hotel, No. 41 on the west side beside Agra Place, from 1867 to 1905. In 1900 the same number is listed as the Perseverance Hotel.
The Pelham Hotel of Mary Mather, on the corner of Pelham Street, listed under Barry Street as well as Pelham Street from 1874 to 1878.
Lerwill and Son, chair makers, No. 47 (1900), and a private hospital kept by Miss Eva Collinson at No. 121 (1905).
University Square, listed as a reserve on the east side from 1895, with the Victorian Lawn Tennis Court and the Victoria Bowling Green from 1905 to 1920.
A straw hat factory at Nos 65 to 67, first under C. P. Jensen (1915) and later Rupert V. Kirsch (1930); Donnellan and Co., boot manufacturers, at the same address in 1925.
The telephone exchange on the east side, 1925 to 1935, and Fred Price Pty Ltd, motor engineers, at Nos 40 to 42 (1935).

div.p: In 1930 and 1935 a few houses are listed only by the occupants' nationality, such as "Chinese" at Nos 32 and 131, "Italians" at No. 70 and "Greeks" at No. 62.

div.head: Records
div.p: Every directory and electoral-roll listing for Barry Street can be browsed in search. Each directory year links to its own page from Sands & McDougall Directories.
